summary: San Juan Lookout site, Orange County: 7-foot open timber tower built by 1922 (or circa 1930), now gone; removal date unknown; trail still leads from the fire station.

notes_for_editor: Only two sources, both register-style pages that share their text. Build year conflicts (1922 register vs circa 1930 chapter); the register's Built field is used. Neither source states access, so facts.access is omitted rather than guessed (brief had unknown). The californialookouts.weebly.com San Juan page was read: its header lists 'California Department of Forestry' and 'Removed' with no narrative, which conflicts with the USFS agency; it is not cited. No staffing dates or fires found in the sources read; the emergency-staffing line is kept as 'thought to have been used'. No photos.
